notes:
Inbound via docs template -> sign-up (self-serve). Early-stage B2B SaaS (SaaS: customer success chat in-app). Team: 14 eng, product-led growth. Primary ask: low-latency streaming chat API for embedded in-app assistant. Priority: first-token latency <150-200ms for US users; smooth streaming experience (partial tokens) to feel instant. Typical session length ~80 tokens; concurrent active users target 150-250 at peak.

Trial behaviour: created account, ran quick latency tests vs. OpenAI, saw higher cold-start times with competitor. Wants drop-in streaming that can be toggled from SDK. Cost sensitivity moderate — looking for predictable per-token pricing and possibility to pin to smaller model if needed.

Model preferences: open/Redwood-verified models preferred for cost control. Wants ability to route by latency: primary hosted model in us-west, fallback smaller variant in us-east if surge. Interested in built-in streaming + function calling for tool integration.

Security/compliance: SOC2 nice-to-have but not blocker; must have audit logs and US data residency for first phase. No on-prem or VPC required for now. No enterprise procurement yet — single PO expected if pilot looks good.

Quotes from call: "We need the chat to feel instantaneous — users drop off if the bot stalls." "If you can show sustained 150ms first-byte and clear cost numbers, we can move to pilot quickly."

POC plan (proposed): 1) Provision hosted API trial keys + SDK sample; 2) Integrate streaming in React app and smoke test; 3) 1-week load run to validate 200 concurrent active users; 4) Cost projection and routing plan; 5) Decision.

Notes/links: POC deck in Drive, Fireflies of discovery call attached. SE Diego to run tech onboarding. Owner Ava coordinating commercial follow-up.
